<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkAndLiveInAustria"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest" name="Request for additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLiveInAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CompetentAuthority" name="Competent representation or visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DocumentRequest" name="Request additional documents" sourceRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Send visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Relocation planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Review requirements for working and living in Austria, including the applicable visa or residence pathway.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineVisaRoute" name="Determine visa route and competent authority">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases, they may be issued by certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, by state police headquarters. Schengen visas are handled by the representation of the country of the main travel destination. If equal time is planned in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. For category A and C applications, territorial competence generally lies with the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal residence. A representation may exceptionally accept a legally resident third-country national not registered in its district if the applicant justifies the submission there. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on place of residence or centre of interest, verifiable, for example, by registration forms, residence permits or visas. Check the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs website for representation office details and local requirements. Contact the representation in advance for more information.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareApplication" name="Prepare visa application and supporting documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the visa application form; a travel document valid in Austria for at least three months beyond the visa duration, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years; a passport photo in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, meeting the specified criteria; fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay, valid throughout the Schengen area with cover of at least 30,000 Euro; proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the stay and return journey; and other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, such as hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location. Confirm the absence of other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country. Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested. The stated interval for applying for or renewing the visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card is unspecified; handle this step at the applicable required interval.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAuthority" name="Wait for authority response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" name="Receive request for additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive visa decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Preparations complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Accommodation, bank account and visa process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Split" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_VisaRoute" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_DetermineVisaRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaRoute_Prepare" sourceRef="Task_DetermineVisaRoute" targetRef="Task_PrepareApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Submit" sourceRef="Task_PrepareApplication" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAuthority"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_DocumentRequest" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAuthority" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAuthority" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentRequest_Send" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAuthority"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
